name: Google grpc crate (Rust)
description: Official Rust implementation of gRPC (grpc crate); 0.9 preview has no usable server

upstream_pin.notes: crates.io max stable at pin time; server module is `pub(crate)` in 0.9.0, so the peer is upstream-incapable until a later release opens it

server.description: SB-18 google-grpc interop server (tests/interop/google-grpc; blocked on the upstream usability gate)
server.usability_gate: Pinned grpc 0.9.0 declares `pub(crate) mod server` (verified from crate source 2026-09-29). Re-check on every version bump; the peer runs only where its server is usable.

transport_contract.mechanism: to be set through the upstream server builder once usable; same SB-01 values, getsockopt-verified

client.reason: No open-loop client driver for google-grpc; optional client cells are not_run. Server cells use the native generator.

tls.reason: Server unusable in grpc 0.9.0, so no TLS path exists yet; the harness contract will serve the in-tree PEM test PKI once the upstream gate clears.
